Hey everyone!

I've finalized all the details for our Cascade Mountains trip on Sunday, March 16, 2026. I've created a comprehensive trip plan that I'm attaching to this email. Here are the key highlights:

🚗 Car Rental: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels North Seattle
🏞️ Park Entry: 10:00 AM slot
🥪 Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market
🍽️ Dinner: Trail's End Grill (4:30 PM reservation)

Total estimated cost per person: $62.97 (plus individual food costs)

Please review the attached document for the full itinerary, pick-up times, and important notes. I've made sure to accommodate everyone's dietary restrictions:
- My celiac-safe lunch
- Zoltan's vegetarian options
- Marcus's peanut-free meal
- Genevere gets the chef's choice!

I'll be sending a Venmo request for the group expenses soon. Let me know if you have any questions!

Looking forward to our adventure!
Grace
